claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year FHA loan rates hover around 6.05% to 6.15%.
Bankrate lists the 30-year FHA rate at approximately 6.15%.
As of March 26, 2026, 30-Year Fixed FHA rates are in the 5.875% to 6.15% range.
As of March 26, 2026, 15-Year Fixed FHA rates are in the 5.75% to 5.85% range.
As of March 26, 2026, 30-Year FHA Refinance rates are approximately 6.14% to 6.54%.
A minimum of 3.5% down payment is required for FHA loans with credit scores of 580 or higher.
10% down payment is required for FHA loans with credit scores between 500 and 579.
FHA loans require an upfront mortgage insurance premium of 1.75%.
The upfront mortgage insurance premium for FHA loans is usually financed into the loan.
FHA loans require monthly mortgage insurance premiums ranging from 0.45% to 1.05%.
